handoff_title: Trusted External Reconstruction and True Process-Boundary Restart Qualification
problem: F-KT12 qualifies opaque typed committed-state export and restore inside a live process, but the opaque carrier can only be constructed from a live ready kernel_committed_state_t. After total process loss there is no qualified adapter-facing path that reconstructs the carrier from an externally persisted representation.
why_this_is_separate: F-KT12 contract explicitly keeps serialization adapters out of scope
kernel must remain free of filesystem, path, parser and byte-format knowledge
generic external reconstruction needs a trust boundary and physical-state codec/layout ownership that belong outside the numerical kernel
adding a public raw revision or lineage constructor to F-KT12 would violate the logical integrity requirement

kernel: retain no public raw revision setter
retain no public raw lineage setter
runtime_or_adapter: own external representation and serialization format
own physical-state codec registry keyed by qualified template/layout identity
validate layout/template identity before physical-state decoding
validate lineage, revision and committed-time metadata as one provenance record rather than independent setters
fail closed on missing, partial, duplicate or incompatible decoded state
do not persist forcing, solver scratch, Jacobians, Newton vectors or worker warm-start state
do not duplicate immutable parameter objects when a stable parameter/template reference is sufficient

trust_model.note: Without cryptographic authenticity, a kernel cannot distinguish a maliciously forged externally decoded revision from a legitimately persisted one. The intended requirement is therefore API and provenance integrity: only the trusted persistence adapter may perform reconstruction, and ordinary runtime callers must not receive a revision/lineage mutation API.

recommended_process_boundary_test.producer_executable: construct deterministic committed state, advance T0->T1, export through qualified F-KT12 typed seam, serialize only in adapter layer, then exit
recommended_process_boundary_test.artifact: adapter-owned versioned test artifact outside kernel source and APIs
recommended_process_boundary_test.consumer_executable: start as a new process, decode and validate artifact through trusted adapter, reconstruct generic committed state, continue T1->T2
recommended_process_boundary_test.expected: exact deterministic endpoint identity and exact lineage/revision/time continuation
recommended_process_boundary_test.important: The producer and consumer must be separate OS processes for the true crash/process-restart claim; simply deallocating an object inside one process is already covered by F-KT12 and is insufficient.

required_gates: exact continuous versus two-process split-run endpoint physical identity
pre-restart stale provenance remains stale where such provenance is deliberately persisted for the test
complete water mass ledger with no initial-storage double count
truncated or incomplete external representation fails closed
duplicate or inconsistent provenance fields fail closed
request, forcing and immutable parameter references remain nonmutated
multiswap_requirements: carrier remains compact per logical column
template/layout identity remains external to mutable physical state
shared immutable parameters are referenced rather than copied per column
optional continuation state is serialized only for active features
batch or pooled serialization may be added later without changing the per-column logical restore contract
do_not_do: put file paths or file units in kernel
put JSON or binary parsing in kernel
silently reinterpret incompatible schema or layout
